exceptions.reason: Fixed GET-only public OAuth discovery returns configured resource/issuer/scopes and immediately returns. It cannot call the MCP handler: /mcp alone proceeds to JWT signature/issuer/audience/lifetime validation and tool scopes. Regression public OAuth discovery cannot dispatch protected MCP tools verifies both discovery URLs, POST refusal, unauthenticated GET/POST/DELETE and encoded/query variants without any service or printer dispatch.
